resources.name: NGSI-LD API
resources.description:
The NGSI-LD API (ETSI GS CIM 009) of this dataset: query, filter and page its entities. The first ten of a type:

    curl -H 'Accept: application/ld+json' 'https://dev.joinedcontext.com/api/endpoint/k7m2q4hkiair/ngsi-ld/v1/entities?type=<Type>&limit=10'

Always live: the catalogue holds this link, never a copy. Open to anyone, with no sign-in.

resources.name: Live updates over WebSocket
resources.description:
Live updates: open one WebSocket, subscribe to the entities you want, and each change arrives as a message, with no server of your own. With websocat, then type the subscription:

    websocat 'wss://dev.joinedcontext.com/api/endpoint/k7m2q4hkiair/ws'
    {"metadata":{"x-op":"x-subscribe","x-id":"s1"},"body":{"type":"Subscription","entities":[{"type":"<Type>"}]}}

Always live: the catalogue holds this link, never a copy. Open to anyone, with no sign-in.

resources.name: Model Context Protocol
resources.description: For AI assistants: a Model Context Protocol server over this dataset's endpoint https://dev.joinedcontext.com/api/endpoint/k7m2q4hkiair. It answers anyone, with no sign-in, what the endpoint serves the public.
